resolved.title: 数据封装
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Hiding[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A key part of object-oriented programming is [b]encapsulation[/b], which involves packaging of related variables and functions into a single easy-to-use object -- an instance of a class.
A related concept is [b]data hiding[/b], which states that implementation details of a class should be hidden, and a clean standard interface be presented for those who want to use the class. 
In other programming languages, this is usually done with private methods and attributes, which block external access to certain methods and attributes in a class.

The Python philosophy is slightly different. It is often stated as [b]"we are all consenting adults here"[/b], meaning that you shouldn't put arbitrary restrictions on accessing parts of a class. Hence there are no ways of enforcing that a method or attribute be strictly private. 
[note]However, there are ways to discourage people from accessing parts of a class, such as by denoting that it is an implementation detail, and should be used at their own risk.[/note]

content.text:
面向对象编程的一个关键部分是**封装**，它涉及将相关的变量和函数打包成一个易于使用的对象--类的实例。

一个相关的概念是**数据封装**，它表明一个类的实现细节哪些应该被隐藏，并为那些想使用该类的人提供一个干净的标准接口。

在其他编程语言中，这通常是通过**私有方法**和**私有属性**来实现的，这些方法和属性阻止外部对类中某些方法和属性进行访问。

Python的理念略有不同，更倾向于"我们同都是成年人，你自己做主 “，意思是你不应该对访问一个类的某些部分进行限制。因此，没有办法强制要求一个方法或属性是严格私有的。
content.text_html:
A key part of object-oriented programming is encapsulation, which involves packaging of related variables and functions into a single easy-to-use object -- an instance of a class. A related concept is data hiding, which states that implementation details of a class should be hidden, and a clean standard interface be presented for those who want to use the class. In other programming languages, this is usually done with private methods and attributes, which block external access to certain methods and attributes in a class.

The Python philosophy is slightly different. It is often stated as "we are all consenting adults here", meaning that you shouldn't put arbitrary restrictions on accessing parts of a class. Hence there are no ways of enforcing that a method or attribute be strictly private.

面向对象编程的一个关键部分是封装，它涉及到将相关的变量和函数打包成一个易于使用的对象--一个类的实例。 一个相关的概念是数据隐藏，它指出一个类的实现细节应该被隐藏，并为那些想使用该类的人提供一个干净的标准接口。 在其他编程语言中，这通常是通过私有方法和属性来实现的，这些方法和属性阻止外部对类中某些方法和属性的访问。

Python 的理念略有不同。它经常被表述为**"我们都是同意的成年人 "**，意思是你不应该对访问一个类的某些部分施加任意的限制。因此，没有办法强制要求一个方法或属性是严格私有的。

content.text: 然而，有一些方法可以阻止人们访问一个类的部分内容，但使用时需自担风险。

resolved.title: 数据封装
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Hiding[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Weakly private methods and attributes have a [b]single underscore [/b]at the beginning.
This signals that they are private, and shouldn't be used by external code. However, it is mostly only a convention, and does not stop external code from accessing them.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="416"]class Queue:
  def __init__(self, contents):
    self.[b]_hiddenlist [/b]= list(contents)

  def push(self, value):
    self.[b]_hiddenlist[/b].insert(0, value)
   
  def pop(self):
    return self.[b]_hiddenlist[/b].pop(-1)

  def __repr__(self):
    return "Queue({})".format(self.[b]_hiddenlist[/b])

queue = Queue([1, 2, 3])
print(queue)
queue.push(0)
print(queue)
queue.pop()
print(queue)
print(queue._hiddenlist)[/code]
[note]In the code above, the attribute [b]_hiddenlist [/b]is marked as private, but it can still be accessed in the outside code.
The [b]__repr__[/b] magic method is used for string representation of the instance.[/note]

[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Hiding[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Strongly private methods and attributes have a[b] double underscore[/b] at the beginning of their names. This causes their names to be mangled, which means that they can't be accessed from outside the class. 
The purpose of this isn't to ensure that they are kept private, but to avoid bugs if there are subclasses that have methods or attributes with the same names.
Name mangled methods can still be accessed externally, but by a different name. The method [b]__privatemethod[/b] of class [b]Spam [/b]could be accessed externally with[b] _Spam__privatemethod[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="417"]class Spam:
 [b] __egg = 7[/b]
  def print_egg(self):
    print(self.__egg)

s = Spam()
s.print_egg()
print(s._Spam__egg)
print(s.__egg)[/code]
[note]Basically, Python protects those members by internally changing the name to include the class name.[/note]

**强**私有方法和属性在其名子的开头有一个**双下划线**`__`。这将导致它们的名字被隐藏，意味着它们不能从类外访问。

这样做的目的不是为了确保它们是私有的，而是为了避免在有子类有同名方法或属性时出现错误。

名字被隐藏的方法仍然可以被外部访问，但要用不同的名字，如类**Spam**的方法`__privatemethod`可以通过`_Spam__privatemethod`进行外部访问。

**例子：**
content.text_html:
Strongly private methods and attributes have a** double underscore** at the beginning of their names. This causes their names to be mangled, which means that they can't be accessed from outside the class. The purpose of this isn't to ensure that they are kept private, but to avoid bugs if there are subclasses that have methods or attributes with the same names. Name mangled methods can still be accessed externally, but by a different name. The method __privatemethod of class Spam could be accessed externally with _Spam__privatemethod.

Example:

强隐私方法和属性在其名称的开头有一个的双下划线。这将导致它们的名字被篡改，这意味着它们不能从类之外被访问。 这样做的目的不是为了确保它们是私有的，而是为了避免在有子类有相同名称的方法或属性时出现错误。 名字被篡改的方法仍然可以被外部访问，但要用不同的名字。类Spam的方法__privatemethod可以通过_Spam__privatemethod**进行外部访问。

class Spam:
    __egg = 7
    def print_egg(self):
        print(self.__egg)

s = Spam()
s.print_egg()
# 正常打印
print(s._Spam__egg)
# 下面代码将报错
print(s.__egg)
